subject: Next step: ops & architecture session to align ML infra requirements
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel King <daniel@lumen.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + proposal: ops & architecture session (60-90m)

Hi Daniel — thanks again for the discovery conversation earlier today. Helpful to hear about the latency targets and mixed workload profile (interactive chat + periodic batch embedding jobs).

Recap (brief):
- Primary goals: 50–150 ms p95 for chat; embeddings throughput for nightly indexing jobs; strict data residency for EU customers (future ask).
- Current infra: on-prem GPUs for training, cloud inference now in early evaluation.
- Decision criteria: latency, unit cost, capability to run mixed models, and auditability.

Proposed next step: 60–90 minute technical ops & architecture session with your infra/ML engineering + our ML infra leads to map a proposed serving topology and discuss SLA/cost tradeoffs. Suggested attendees:
- From LumenAI: you + Erin (infra) + one engineer who owns deployment gating
- From Redwood: me (sales), Priyom (solutions engineer) and Sergio (ML infra lead — will join if available)

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue 2026-08-03: 09:30–11:00 or 13:00–14:30
- Wed 2026-08-04: 10:00–11:30

Draft agenda attached (ops-tdx agenda v1) — short walkthrough (15m) of Lumen workload, 40–60m architecture discussion, 10–15m action items + mutual action plan. Can adjust length based on how deep you want to go.

If you prefer, I can send a calendar invite for one of the slots. What works best?

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-ops-tdx-agenda-v1.md (markdown), prelim-capacity-estimate.xlsx (xls)

Sergio — looping you in. Lumen confirmed Tue 2026-08-03 09:30–11:00 PDT for the ops / architecture session. They will bring Sam (infra) and a security contact.

As discussed, key areas we should be prepared to cover:
- Serving topology options: single-tenant Dedicated vs mixed-hosted routing
- Latency optimizations (prefix cache, kv-cache sizing, batching windows)
- Quantization/throughput tradeoffs for their model family (likely LlamaX-34B variant)
- SLO/cost projections (use simple buckets - low/med/high)

Can you confirm if you can join at 09:30? If not, Priyom will run and capture notes.

Thanks — send any slide snippets or a 1-page note you want me to attach to the invite.

Naomi
